summary: Most of the feature set is in place and matches the agreed decisions. That covers 8 ports with pins, free mind maps with per-node colour and ↺ Auto layout, the ```sequence kind, SVG/PNG download (white background, 2× PNG, named '<Chapter>-<kind>-<n>.<ext>' through ScuLaFolder.save, buttons in the modal and on the preview), and sketch.js (pen/highlighter/eraser, 6 colours, 3 widths, undo/redo, ✎ on any preview picture, one markdown undo step). No dependency was added. I ran the suites myself; the latest test report never did (its Bash was refused), and the implementer ran none of them. Results: the tester suite (`npm test` at the repo root) passes 150 of 151, and tests/codecopy.js, timeline.js, mdundo.js and cause.js all pass. It is not mergeable. First, the product owner's first binding decision was 're-verify with /apptest diagram and fix any failures before adding anything', and `node tests/diagram.js` still fails one check. Second, the one failing tester check is a real bug: Escape does nothing in either modal when focus is outside it. The code's own comment says this happens after a click on the bar's empty space. Third, the branch is behind main by several commits that edit the shared nav in all eight pages, so /verify must be re-run after syncing. A scratch file is also committed.

BUG — Escape does not close the ◇ Diagram or ✏ Sketch modal when focus is outside it. Reproduced by tests/01-for-index-html-page-please-add/exclusive.spec.js:49: after focus lands on the page behind, Escape leaves dg.open true and the next click is intercepted by the modal. The same happens for real after a click on non-focusable modal chrome, which leaves focus on <body>. Cause: Escape, Ctrl+Z/Y and the tool keys are handled only by the listeners on the modal element (diagram.js:1370 dgKeyDown, sketch.js:245). events.js:31-32 returns early while either modal is open, and the capture-phase document listeners (diagram.js:1372, sketch.js:254) only handle Tab. Fix: in both capture listeners, when the target is outside the open modal, send any key that is not Tab to the modal's handler after focusing its stage. In diagram.js that is `stage.focus(); dgKeyDown(e)`; factor sketch.js's inline handler into a named skKeyDown and do the same. Then make exclusive.spec.js pass and add one case: click the empty toolbar area, press Escape, assert the modal is closed.
